rationale: This mutation eliminates the -$10,999 cash deficit by synchronizing progressive plot expansion (6-8 plots at 3 hands, 10-12 at 5 hands, and a strict 16-plot ceiling by Day 13 at 8+ hands) dedicated to 12-14 Strawberry perennial plots, guaranteeing 5+ compounding harvest cycles without labor surplus. It fixes farm execution by preserving in-situ watering directly after cluster harvesting to prevent growth-timer freezes while chaining fertilizer retrieval immediately after shed deposits to eliminate bag deadlocks. Finally, it resolves margin bleed and cash freezes with a dynamic two-phase liquidation policy (>=0.82x Days 1-8, >=0.88x Days 9-28 with shed relief, terminal Day 30 sweep), elevates Oracle front-running to priority 3, purges zero-animal wheat reserves, and enforces strict maturation seed phase-gates.
